# HybridPETs 2027

> HybridPETs 2027 is the 1st International Workshop on Hybrid Privacy-Enhancing Technologies, a full-day, in-person workshop co-located with ACNS 2027, the 25th International Conference on Applied Cryptography and Network Security (28 June – 1 July 2027), at Royal Holloway, University of London, in Egham, United Kingdom.

The workshop is dedicated to combinations of privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs), such as secure multi-party computation (MPC), homomorphic encryption (HE), trusted execution environments (TEEs), differential privacy (DP), zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs), and private information retrieval (PIR): how they can be combined securely and efficiently, which end-to-end guarantees the resulting systems provide, and how they can be implemented, accelerated, verified, and deployed.

The website is the authoritative source for the call for papers, the deadlines, the workshop date, and the program committee.

## Website

- [Call for Papers](https://hybridpets.github.io/#call-for-papers): scope, topics of interest, submission guidelines, and publication in the joint ACNS 2027 workshop post-proceedings (Springer LNCS)
- [Important dates](https://hybridpets.github.io/#dates): submission, notification, and camera-ready deadlines, and the workshop date
- [Organization](https://hybridpets.github.io/#organization): PC chairs, web chair, program committee, and contact address
- [Location and registration](https://hybridpets.github.io/#location): venue, travel, accommodation, and registration through ACNS 2027

## Related

- [Submission site](https://submit.acns2027.com/hybridpets/): where papers are submitted
- [ACNS 2027](https://acns2027.isg.rhul.ac.uk/): the host conference
